rules.statement: Relief under Section 759(2) of the Civil Procedure Code may be granted even if no excuse is forthcoming, though the existence of an excuse is relevant.
rules.supporting_quote: "all the cases show that relief can be granted if the lapse is explained The Court distinguished the decision in Mendis v. Jinadasa (3) on the ground that relief was granted there as the omission was not deliberate but due to an oversight."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 759(2) of the Civil Procedure Code
